name: Foot plate
process: laser cut, drill, tap M16, weld

name: Post
process: saw cut, drill index holes on a jig, weld
notes: index holes on 50 mm pitch, ±0.2 mm cumulative

name: Diagonal
process: saw cut both ends at 50.1° (on the CAD), weld
notes: end cuts as modelled; fit-up gap ≤ 2 mm before welding

name: Levelling foot M16 × 100, Ø80 swivel base, NBR pad, ≥ 5 kN
Saddle front plate
process: laser cut, drill, weld seat block

name: Seat block (welded to the front plate)
process: saw cut, mill top flat, drill, tap, weld
notes: top face flat 0.1 mm and flush with the front plate top

name: Boom flange
process: laser cut, weld, then face-mill and drill after welding
notes: front face flat 0.05 mm and square to the tube axis 0.1 mm after welding

name: Head frame (fixed): back wall, torque-flexure collar, torque-cell bracket
process: CNC mill from solid, 3 setups; wire-EDM the collar slots
notes: collar slots 0.17 +0.01/0 wide; collar bore concentric to the dowel holes 0.02 mm

name: Torque stage (one piece): hub, plate, arms, torque arm
process: CNC turn the hub, mill the rest from solid; wire-EDM the hub slots
notes: hub slots 0.17 +0.01/0; rib faces flat 0.01 and parallel 0.01 mm; torque-cell hole at r = 100 ± 0.05 mm

name: Thrust carriage
notes: rib faces flat 0.01 mm, parallel to the torque-stage ribs 0.02 mm when assembled; lightest part of the head: no material may be added

name: Load cell, micro S-type, 5 kg, M6×1, 0.05 % FS (thrust)
notes: ATO DYLY-106 class: 25 × 30 × 12 mm, 2 × M6×1 (datasheet drawing); measure on delivery

name: Thrust flexure blade
process: wire-EDM or photo-etch from shim, deburr
notes: free length 35 mm between clamp edges; no scratches across the width; edges deburred

name: Blade clamp bar
notes: clamp face ground flat 0.005 mm; clamp edge sharp

name: Torque flexure blade
process: wire-EDM or photo-etch from shim, deburr
notes: free length 25 mm between slot edges

name: Load cell, micro S-type, 2 kg, M6×1, 0.05 % FS (torque)
Motor adapter (one per motor pattern)
notes: motor pattern: placeholder until the motor drawing is in hand; faces parallel 0.02 mm

name: Portal post
process: saw cut, drill on a jig, weld
notes: holes on 50 mm pitch, ±0.2 mm cumulative, both posts drilled as a pair

name: Portal knee brace
process: saw cut both ends (on the CAD), weld

name: Guard band (rolled steel, butt-welded)
process: roll sheet to Ø, butt weld, grind flush
notes: contains a 20 J blade fragment (≈ 35 J to perforate); paint high-visibility

name: Thrust calibration plate (replaces the motor adapter)
notes: eye bolt DIN 580 M8; pull line on the thrust axis ±0.5 mm

name: Torque calibration bar
process: CNC mill, jig-bore the load-pin holes
notes: load-pin holes at the radii ±0.02 mm from the pattern centre
